have hpt : ∀ t, etaO t * etaO (ρ - t) =
      (etaO t ^ 2 + etaO (t + s) ^ 2 - (etaO (t + s) - etaO t) ^ 2) / 2 := fun t => by
    rw [hsym]; ring
  have heq : conv2 ρ = (∫ t, etaO t ^ 2) - (1 / 2) * ∫ t, (etaO (t + s) - etaO t) ^ 2 := by
    unfold conv2
    simp_rw [hpt]
    have h1 : Integrable fun t => etaO t ^ 2 + etaO (t + s) ^ 2 := integrable_etaO_sq.add hshift
    rw [integral_div, integral_sub h1 hdiff, integral_add integrable_etaO_sq hshift,

proof_context.conclusion: Exact polarization $\eta_\circ(t)\eta_\circ(\rho-t)=\tfrac12(\eta_\circ(t)^2+\eta_\circ(t+s)^2-(\eta_\circ(t+s)-\eta_\circ(t))^2)$ integrated with translation invariance gives `conv2 ρ = ‖η◦‖₂² − ½∫(η◦(t+s)−η◦(t))²`, i.e. $\langle v,w\rangle=|v|_2|w|_2-\tfrac12|v-w|_2^2$ for $|w|_2=|v|_2$.
